title: Record the promotion-time dev read-back in the repository profile
description: During glyph-cli's first promotion to main on 2026-09-29, refs/heads/dev disappeared from the remote and had to be recreated at the promoted SHA. The cause is still open under opum-agent OPAG-844 and the GitHub events API does not record the deletion, so neither candidate fix is chosen yet; delete_branch_on_merge stays on per opum-agent. What cannot wait for the mechanism is the check: the next promotion is the only thing that can reproduce it, so the operator of the next promotion needs to know to look. opum-agent instruction 2026-09-29: at every promotion, read dev back after the push as well as main, and report it if it is gone. Captured in the repository profile rather than only in a session, per the operating model continuous-improvement duty: when corrected, capture the rule, not the incident, and put it where it will be read.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The repository profile states, under Constraints and couplings to respect, that dev is read back after every promotion and reported if missing, with the date, the incident, and the OPAG-844 reference
lore check --strict and both required CI contexts are green on the SHA that lands

finalSummary: Added to the CLAUDE.md repository profile, under Constraints and couplings to respect: dev is read back after every promotion, not only main, with the date, the incident (refs/heads/dev disappeared from the remote during this repositorys first promotion to main), the still-open cause (opum-agent OPAG-844), and the explicit instruction to report it if it is gone, plus the command to re-take the measurement. Verified: lore validate --strict and lore check --strict both exit 0 on the branch, and both required CI contexts are green on the landed SHA (opum-ai/glyph-cli#7, Docs pass in 13s, Tracker integrity pass). The incident itself is not fixed here: the mechanism is open under OPAG-844 and delete_branch_on_merge stays on per that ruling, so this task records the check that catches a recurrence and nothing more.
